hypothesis: Compare whether frozen fine-tuned Kronos v5 context adds development utility beyond the same 40 raw features with the same candidate tree head.
policy: Unchanged v5 policy: expected net0.3%, fill0.25, cooldown5days, max4/month, 1x. No threshold sweep.
fit_scope: PCA/scaling and forests fitted on train only. v5 checkpoint selection already used validation, so all comparisons are development evidence, not independent tests.
decision: Require both validation and policy positive net/stress, DD<=20%, at least15 combined fills for every seed before further validation work. This is a preliminary screen, not final live acceptance. Retain every result and do not pick only a winning seed.
